<p class="text-inherit font-normal text-base [&amp;_strong]:wrap-break-word mb-[1.5ch]" data-text="true">The <a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" class="cursor-pointer decoration-0 hocus:opacity-80 font-normal text-link visited:text-link hocus:underline [&amp;_code]:hocus:underline [&amp;_b]:text-link [&amp;_code]:text-link [&amp;_em]:text-link [&amp;_i]:text-link [&amp;_span]:text-link [&amp;_strong]:text-link" href="https://developer.android.com/media/media3/exoplayer/supported-formats">Android media format support documentation</a> covers formats supported when using Expo Player on Android. The <a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" class="cursor-pointer decoration-0 hocus:opacity-80 font-normal text-link visited:text-link hocus:underline [&amp;_code]:hocus:underline [&amp;_b]:text-link [&amp;_code]:text-link [&amp;_em]:text-link [&amp;_i]:text-link [&amp;_span]:text-link [&amp;_strong]:text-link" href="https://developer.apple.com/documentation/coreaudiotypes/audio-format-identifiers">iOS audio and video format documentation</a> lists supported media formats for Apple devices.</p>
<p class="text-inherit font-normal text-base [&amp;_strong]:wrap-break-word mb-[1.5ch]" data-text="true">Note that audio automatically stops if headphones/Bluetooth audio devices are disconnected.</p>

<h2 class="text-inherit text-[25px] leading-[1.4] font-bold tracking-[-0.021rem] mt-8 mb-3.5 [&amp;_code]:text-[90%] max-md:text-[22px] max-md:leading-[1.409] max-sm:text-[19px] max-sm:leading-[1.5263] group flex gap-1 scroll-m-5" data-heading="true" id="configuration-in-app-config">Configuration in app config<a class="border border-solid rounded-full font-medium items-center whitespace-nowrap gap-2 text-sm border-button-quaternary bg-button-quaternary text-button-quaternary shadow-none hocus:bg-button-quaternary-hover active:scale-98 relative my-auto inline-flex size-6.25 min-w-6.25 justify-center p-0 transition-all duration-default invisible opacity-0 group-hover:visible group-hover:opacity-100 group-focus-visible:visible group-focus-visible:opacity-100" href="/versions/v57.0.0/sdk/audio#configuration-in-app-config"><span class="flex self-center text-inherit leading-none select-none"><svg aria-label="permalink" class="icon-sm shrink-0" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M10 13a5 5 0 007.54.54l3-3a5 5 0 00-7.07-7.07l-1.72 1.71" stroke="#9B9B9B" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"></path><path d="M14 11a5 5 0 00-7.54-.54l-3 3a5 5 0 007.07 7.07l1.71-1.71" stroke="#9B9B9B" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"></path></svg></span></a></h2>
<p class="text-inherit font-normal text-base [&amp;_strong]:wrap-break-word mb-[1.5ch]" data-text="true">You can configure <code class="text-inherit text-xs leading-[130%] font-normal inline-block rounded-md border border-secondary bg-subtle px-1 py-0.5" data-text="true">expo-audio</code> using its built-in <a class="cursor-pointer decoration-0 hocus:opacity-80 font-normal text-link visited:text-link hocus:underline [&amp;_code]:hocus:underline [&amp;_b]:text-link [&amp;_code]:text-link [&amp;_em]:text-link [&amp;_i]:text-link [&amp;_span]:text-link [&amp;_strong]:text-link" href="/config-plugins/introduction">config plugin</a> if you use config plugins in your project (<a class="cursor-pointer decoration-0 hocus:opacity-80 font-normal text-link visited:text-link hocus:underline [&amp;_code]:hocus:underline [&amp;_b]:text-link [&amp;_code]:text-link [&amp;_em]:text-link [&amp;_i]:text-link [&amp;_span]:text-link [&amp;_strong]:text-link" href="/workflow/continuous-native-generation">Continuous Native Generation (CNG)</a>). The plugin allows you to configure various properties that cannot be set at runtime and require building a new app binary to take effect. If your app does <span class="leading-[1.6154] text-inherit font-semibold" data-text="true">not</span> use CNG, then you&#x27;ll need to manually configure the library.</p>

<p class="text-inherit font-normal text-base [&amp;_strong]:wrap-break-word mb-[1.5ch]" data-text="true">On Android and iOS, <code class="text-inherit text-xs leading-[130%] font-normal inline-block rounded-md border border-secondary bg-subtle px-1 py-0.5" data-text="true">expo-audio</code> saves recordings in the app&#x27;s cache directory by default. The system may delete cache files when the device runs low on storage. To keep new recordings in a more persistent location, pass <code class="text-inherit text-xs leading-[130%] font-normal inline-block rounded-md border border-secondary bg-subtle px-1 py-0.5" data-text="true">{ ...RecordingPresets.HIGH_QUALITY, directory: &#x27;document&#x27; }</code> to <code class="text-inherit text-xs leading-[130%] font-normal inline-block rounded-md border border-secondary bg-subtle px-1 py-0.5" data-text="true">useAudioRecorder</code> or <code class="text-inherit text-xs leading-[130%] font-normal inline-block rounded-md border border-secondary bg-subtle px-1 py-0.5" data-text="true">prepareToRecordAsync()</code>. This stores them under the app&#x27;s document directory. For existing recordings already saved in cache, use the returned recording URI to move them with <a class="cursor-pointer decoration-0 hocus:opacity-80 font-normal text-link visited:text-link hocus:underline [&amp;_code]:hocus:underline [&amp;_b]:text-link [&amp;_code]:text-link [&amp;_em]:text-link [&amp;_i]:text-link [&amp;_span]:text-link [&amp;_strong]:text-link" href="/versions/v57.0.0/sdk/filesystem"><code class="text-inherit text-xs leading-[130%] font-normal inline-block rounded-md border border-secondary bg-subtle px-1 py-0.5" data-text="true">expo-file-system</code></a>.</p>
<h3 class="text-inherit text-[20px] leading-normal font-semibold tracking-[-0.017rem] mt-7 mb-3 [&amp;_code]:text-[90%] max-md:text-[18px] max-md:leading-[1.5555] max-sm:text-[16px] max-sm:leading-relaxed group flex gap-1 scroll-m-5" data-heading="true" id="playing-audio-in-the-background">Playing audio in the background<a class="border border-solid rounded-full font-medium items-center whitespace-nowrap gap-2 text-sm border-button-quaternary bg-button-quaternary text-button-quaternary shadow-none hocus:bg-button-quaternary-hover active:scale-98 relative my-auto inline-flex justify-center p-0 transition-all duration-default invisible opacity-0 group-hover:visible group-hover:opacity-100 group-focus-visible:visible group-focus-visible:opacity-100 size-5.5 min-w-5.5" href="/versions/v57.0.0/sdk/audio#playing-audio-in-the-background"><span class="flex self-center text-inherit leading-none select-none"><svg aria-label="permalink" class="shrink-0 icon-xs" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M10 13a5 5 0 007.54.54l3-3a5 5 0 00-7.07-7.07l-1.72 1.71" stroke="#9B9B9B" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"></path><path d="M14 11a5 5 0 00-7.54-.54l-3 3a5 5 0 007.07 7.07l1.71-1.71" stroke="#9B9B9B" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"></path></svg></span></a></h3>
<p class="text-inherit font-normal text-base [&amp;_strong]:wrap-break-word mb-[1.5ch]" data-text="true">Background audio playback allows your app to continue playing audio when it moves to the background or when the device screen locks.</p>
<h4 class="text-inherit text-[16px] leading-relaxed font-semibold tracking-[-0.011rem] mt-6 mb-2 [&amp;_code]:text-[90%] group flex gap-1 scroll-m-5" data-heading="true" id="configuration">Configuration<a class="border border-solid rounded-full font-medium items-center whitespace-nowrap gap-2 text-sm border-button-quaternary bg-button-quaternary text-button-quaternary shadow-none hocus:bg-button-quaternary-hover active:scale-98 relative my-auto inline-flex justify-center p-0 transition-all duration-default invisible opacity-0 group-hover:visible group-hover:opacity-100 group-focus-visible:visible group-focus-visible:opacity-100 size-5.5 min-w-5.5" href="/versions/v57.0.0/sdk/audio#configuration"><span class="flex self-center text-inherit leading-none select-none"><svg aria-label="permalink" class="shrink-0 icon-xs" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M10 13a5 5 0 007.54.54l3-3a5 5 0 00-7.07-7.07l-1.72 1.71" stroke="#9B9B9B" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"></path><path d="M14 11a5 5 0 00-7.54-.54l-3 3a5 5 0 007.07 7.07l1.71-1.71" stroke="#9B9B9B" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"></path></svg></span></a></h4>
<p class="text-inherit font-normal text-base [&amp;_strong]:wrap-break-word mb-[1.5ch]" data-text="true">To enable background audio playback, use the config plugin in your <a class="cursor-pointer decoration-0 hocus:opacity-80 font-normal text-link visited:text-link hocus:underline [&amp;_code]:hocus:underline [&amp;_b]:text-link [&amp;_code]:text-link [&amp;_em]:text-link [&amp;_i]:text-link [&amp;_span]:text-link [&amp;_strong]:text-link" href="/workflow/configuration">app config</a>:</p>

<p class="text-inherit font-normal text-base [&amp;_strong]:wrap-break-word mb-[1.5ch]" data-text="true">After configuring your app with the config plugin, you need to:</p>

<li class="text-inherit text-base leading-relaxed font-normal mb-2" data-text="true"><span class="leading-[1.6154] text-inherit font-semibold" data-text="true">Configure the audio session</span> to allow background playback</li>
<li class="text-inherit text-base leading-relaxed font-normal mb-2" data-text="true"><span class="leading-[1.6154] text-inherit font-semibold" data-text="true">Enable lock screen controls</span> (required on Android for sustained background playback)</li>
</ol>

<p class="text-inherit font-normal text-base [&amp;_strong]:wrap-break-word mb-[1.5ch]" data-text="true"><span class="leading-[1.6154] text-inherit font-semibold" data-text="true">Note</span>: On Android, you have to enable the lock screen controls with <a class="cursor-pointer decoration-0 hocus:opacity-80 font-normal text-link visited:text-link hocus:underline [&amp;_code]:hocus:underline [&amp;_b]:text-link [&amp;_code]:text-link [&amp;_em]:text-link [&amp;_i]:text-link [&amp;_span]:text-link [&amp;_strong]:text-link" href="/versions/v57.0.0/sdk/audio#setactiveforlockscreenactive-metadata-options"><code class="text-inherit text-xs leading-[130%] font-normal inline-block rounded-md border border-secondary bg-subtle px-1 py-0.5" data-text="true">setActiveForLockScreen</code></a> for sustained background playback. Otherwise, the audio will stop after approximately 3 minutes of background playback (OS limitation). Ensure to appropriately <a class="cursor-pointer decoration-0 hocus:opacity-80 font-normal text-link visited:text-link hocus:underline [&amp;_code]:hocus:underline [&amp;_b]:text-link [&amp;_code]:text-link [&amp;_em]:text-link [&amp;_i]:text-link [&amp;_span]:text-link [&amp;_strong]:text-link" href="/versions/v57.0.0/sdk/audio#configuration-in-app-config">configure the config plugin</a>.</p>
</div></blockquote>

<li class="text-inherit text-base leading-relaxed font-normal mb-2" data-text="true">A media notification appears in the notification drawer with playback controls</li>
<li class="text-inherit text-base leading-relaxed font-normal mb-2" data-text="true">Audio continues playing indefinitely in the background</li>
<li class="text-inherit text-base leading-relaxed font-normal mb-2" data-text="true">Users can control playback from the lock screen and notification</li>
<li class="text-inherit text-base leading-relaxed font-normal mb-2" data-text="true">The foreground service keeps the playback alive during playback</li>

<h4 class="text-inherit text-[16px] leading-relaxed font-semibold tracking-[-0.011rem] mt-6 mb-2 [&amp;_code]:text-[90%] group flex gap-1 scroll-m-5" data-heading="true" id="usage-2">Usage<a class="border border-solid rounded-full font-medium items-center whitespace-nowrap gap-2 text-sm border-button-quaternary bg-button-quaternary text-button-quaternary shadow-none hocus:bg-button-quaternary-hover active:scale-98 relative my-auto inline-flex justify-center p-0 transition-all duration-default invisible opacity-0 group-hover:visible group-hover:opacity-100 group-focus-visible:visible group-focus-visible:opacity-100 size-5.5 min-w-5.5" href="/versions/v57.0.0/sdk/audio#usage-2"><span class="flex self-center text-inherit leading-none select-none"><svg aria-label="permalink" class="shrink-0 icon-xs" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M10 13a5 5 0 007.54.54l3-3a5 5 0 00-7.07-7.07l-1.72 1.71" stroke="#9B9B9B" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"></path><path d="M14 11a5 5 0 00-7.54-.54l-3 3a5 5 0 007.07 7.07l1.71-1.71" stroke="#9B9B9B" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"></path></svg></span></a></h4>
<p class="text-inherit font-normal text-base [&amp;_strong]:wrap-break-word mb-[1.5ch]" data-text="true">After configuring your app, enable background recording at runtime using <a class="cursor-pointer decoration-0 hocus:opacity-80 font-normal text-link visited:text-link hocus:underline [&amp;_code]:hocus:underline [&amp;_b]:text-link [&amp;_code]:text-link [&amp;_em]:text-link [&amp;_i]:text-link [&amp;_span]:text-link [&amp;_strong]:text-link" href="/versions/v57.0.0/sdk/audio#audiosetaudiomodeasyncmode"><code class="text-inherit text-xs leading-[130%] font-normal inline-block rounded-md border border-secondary bg-subtle px-1 py-0.5" data-text="true">setAudioModeAsync</code></a>:</p>
<pre data-md-lang="jsx" class="relative my-4 overflow-x-auto rounded-md border border-secondary bg-subtle whitespace-pre [p+&amp;]:mt-0" data-text="true"><div class="w-fit p-4"><code class="text-xs text-default"><span class="token keyword module">import</span> <span class="token imports"><span class="token punctuation">{</span> setAudioModeAsync<span class="token punctuation">,</span> useAudioRecorder<span class="token punctuation">,</span> <span class="token maybe-class-name">RecordingPresets</span> <span class="token punctuation">}</span></span> <span class="token keyword module">from</span> <span class="token string">'expo-audio'</span><span class="token punctuation">;</span>

<p class="text-inherit font-normal text-base [&amp;_strong]:wrap-break-word mb-[1.5ch]" data-text="true">On Android, background recording requires a foreground service, which displays a persistent notification with the text &quot;Recording audio&quot; and a stop button. This notification cannot be dismissed while recording is active and automatically disappears when recording stops.</p>
<span class="text-inherit font-normal text-[14px] leading-[1.5715] tracking-[-0.006rem] inline-flex items-center" data-text="true"><div data-md="platform-badge" class="mr-2 inline-flex min-h-5.25 aria-hidden="true"><g id="apple-custom-icon"><path id="Vector" fill="currentColor" d="M20.4478 17.3538C20.1312 18.0852 19.7564 18.7585 19.3222 19.3775C18.7303 20.2214 18.2457 20.8055 17.8722 1.45727V1.45728Z"></path></g></svg><span class="text-xs! leading-none! font-normal whitespace-nowrap">iOS</span></div></span>
<p class="text-inherit font-normal text-base [&amp;_strong]:wrap-break-word mb-[1.5ch]" data-text="true">On iOS, background recording continues seamlessly when the app is in the background or the screen locks. No additional notifications or indicators are shown to the app user beyond the system status bar.</p>
<h3 class="text-inherit text-[20px] leading-normal font-semibold tracking-[-0.017rem] mt-7 mb-3 [&amp;_code]:text-[90%] max-md:text-[18px] max-md:leading-[1.5555] max-sm:text-[16px] max-sm:leading-relaxed group flex gap-1 scroll-m-5" data-heading="true" id="using-the-audioplayer-directly">Using the AudioPlayer directly<a class="border border-solid rounded-full font-medium items-center whitespace-nowrap gap-2 text-sm border-button-quaternary bg-button-quaternary text-button-quaternary shadow-none hocus:bg-button-quaternary-hover active:scale-98 relative my-auto inline-flex justify-center p-0 transition-all duration-default invisible opacity-0 group-hover:visible group-hover:opacity-100 group-focus-visible:visible group-focus-visible:opacity-100 size-5.5 min-w-5.5" href="/versions/v57.0.0/sdk/audio#using-the-audioplayer-directly"><span class="flex self-center text-inherit leading-none select-none"><svg aria-label="permalink" class="shrink-0 icon-xs" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M10 13a5 5 0 007.54.54l3-3a5 5 0 00-7.07-7.07l-1.72 1.71" stroke="#9B9B9B" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"></path><path d="M14 11a5 5 0 00-7.54-.54l-3 3a5 5 0 007.07 7.07l1.71-1.71" stroke="#9B9B9B" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"></path></svg></span></a></h3>
<p class="text-inherit font-normal text-base [&amp;_strong]:wrap-break-word mb-[1.5ch]" data-text="true">In most cases, use the <a class="cursor-pointer decoration-0 hocus:opacity-80 font-normal text-link visited:text-link hocus:underline [&amp;_code]:hocus:underline [&amp;_b]:text-link [&amp;_code]:text-link [&amp;_em]:text-link [&amp;_i]:text-link [&amp;_span]:text-link [&amp;_strong]:text-link" href="/versions/v57.0.0/sdk/audio#useaudioplayersource-options"><code class="text-inherit text-xs leading-[130%] font-normal inline-block rounded-md border border-secondary bg-subtle px-1 py-0.5" data-text="true">useAudioPlayer</code></a> hook to create an <code class="text-inherit text-xs leading-[130%] font-normal inline-block rounded-md border border-secondary bg-subtle px-1 py-0.5" data-text="true">AudioPlayer</code> instance. It manages the player&#x27;s lifecycle and ensures proper disposal when the component unmounts. However, in some advanced use cases, you may need to create an <code class="text-inherit text-xs leading-[130%] font-normal inline-block rounded-md border border-secondary bg-subtle px-1 py-0.5" data-text="true">AudioPlayer</code> that persists beyond the component&#x27;s lifecycle.
In those cases, use the <a class="cursor-pointer decoration-0 hocus:opacity-80 font-normal text-link visited:text-link hocus:underline [&amp;_code]:hocus:underline [&amp;_b]:text-link [&amp;_code]:text-link [&amp;_em]:text-link [&amp;_i]:text-link [&amp;_span]:text-link [&amp;_strong]:text-link" href="/versions/v57.0.0/sdk/audio#audiocreateaudioplayersource-options"><code class="text-inherit text-xs leading-[130%] font-normal inline-block rounded-md border border-secondary bg-subtle px-1 py-0.5" data-text="true">createAudioPlayer</code></a> function. You need to be aware of the risks that come with this approach, as it is your responsibility to call the <a class="cursor-pointer decoration-0 hocus:opacity-80 font-normal text-link visited:text-link hocus:underline [&amp;_code]:hocus:underline [&amp;_b]:text-link [&amp;_code]:text-link [&amp;_em]:text-link [&amp;_i]:text-link [&amp;_span]:text-link [&amp;_strong]:text-link" href="/versions/v57.0.0/sdk/expo#release"><code class="text-inherit text-xs leading-[130%] font-normal inline-block rounded-md border border-secondary bg-subtle px-1 py-0.5" data-text="true">release()</code></a> method when the player is no longer needed. If not handled properly, this approach may lead to memory leaks.</p>
<pre data-md-lang="tsx" class="relative my-4 overflow-x-auto rounded-md border border-secondary bg-subtle whitespace-pre [p+&amp;]:mt-0" data-text="true"><div class="w-fit p-4"><code class="text-xs text-default"><span class="token keyword">import</span> <span class="token imports"><span class="token punctuation">{</span> createAudioPlayer <span class="token punctuation">}</span></span> <span class="token keyword">from</span> <span class="token string">'expo-audio'</span><span class="token punctuation">;</span>
<span class="token keyword">const</span> player <span class="token operator">=</span> <span class="token function">createAudioPlayer</span><span class="token punctuation">(</span>audioSource<span class="token punctuation">)</span><span class="token punctuation">;</span>
</code></div></pre>
<h3 class="text-inherit text-[20px] leading-normal font-semibold tracking-[-0.017rem] mt-7 mb-3 [&amp;_code]:text-[90%] max-md:text-[18px] max-md:leading-[1.5555] max-sm:text-[16px] max-sm:leading-relaxed group flex gap-1 scroll-m-5" data-heading="true" id="notes-on-web-usage">Notes on web usage<a class="border border-solid rounded-full font-medium items-center whitespace-nowrap gap-2 text-sm border-button-quaternary bg-button-quaternary text-button-quaternary shadow-none hocus:bg-button-quaternary-hover active:scale-98 relative my-auto inline-flex justify-center p-0 transition-all duration-default invisible opacity-0 group-hover:visible group-hover:opacity-100 group-focus-visible:visible group-focus-visible:opacity-100 size-5.5 min-w-5.5" href="/versions/v57.0.0/sdk/audio#notes-on-web-usage"><span class="flex self-center text-inherit leading-none select-none"><svg aria-label="permalink" class="shrink-0 icon-xs" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M10 13a5 5 0 007.54.54l3-3a5 5 0 00-7.07-7.07l-1.72 1.71" stroke="#9B9B9B" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"></path><path d="M14 11a5 5 0 00-7.54-.54l-3 3a5 5 0 007.07 7.07l1.71-1.71" stroke="#9B9B9B" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"></path></svg></span></a></h3>
<ul class="leading-[1.6154] text-inherit list-disc ml-6 [&amp;_ol]:mt-2 [&amp;_ol]:mb-4 [&amp;_ul]:mt-2 [&amp;_ul]:mb-4 mb-[1.5ch] pl-[1ch]">
<li class="text-inherit text-base leading-relaxed font-normal mb-2" data-text="true">A MediaRecorder issue on Chrome produces WebM files missing the duration metadata. <a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" class="cursor-pointer decoration-0 hocus:opacity-80 font-normal text-link visited:text-link hocus:underline [&amp;_code]:hocus:underline [&amp;_b]:text-link [&amp;_code]:text-link [&amp;_em]:text-link [&amp;_i]:text-link [&amp;_span]:text-link [&amp;_strong]:text-link" href="https://bugs.chromium.org/p/chromium/issues/detail?id=642012">See the open Chromium issue</a>.</li>
<li class="text-inherit text-base leading-relaxed font-normal mb-2" data-text="true">MediaRecorder encoding options and other configurations are inconsistent across browsers. Using a polyfill such as <a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" class="cursor-pointer decoration-0 hocus:opacity-80 font-normal text-link visited:text-link hocus:underline [&amp;_code]:hocus:underline [&amp;_b]:text-link [&amp;_code]:text-link [&amp;_em]:text-link [&amp;_i]:text-link [&amp;_span]:text-link [&amp;_strong]:text-link" href="https://github.com/kbumsik/opus-media-recorder">kbumsik/opus-media-recorder</a> or <a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" class="cursor-pointer decoration-0 hocus:opacity-80 font-normal text-link visited:text-link hocus:underline [&amp;_code]:hocus:underline [&amp;_b]:text-link [&amp;_code]:text-link [&amp;_em]:text-link [&amp;_i]:text-link [&amp;_span]:text-link [&amp;_strong]:text-link" href="https://github.com/ai/audio-recorder-polyfill">ai/audio-recorder-polyfill</a> in your application will improve your experience. Any options passed to <code class="text-inherit text-xs leading-[130%] font-normal inline-block rounded-md border border-secondary bg-subtle px-1 py-0.5" data-text="true">prepareToRecordAsync</code> will be passed directly to the MediaRecorder API and as such the polyfill.</li>
<li class="text-inherit text-base leading-relaxed font-normal mb-2" data-text="true">Web browsers require sites to be served securely for them to listen to a mic. See <a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" class="cursor-pointer decoration-0 hocus:opacity-80 font-normal text-link visited:text-link hocus:underline [&amp;_code]:hocus:underline [&amp;_b]:text-link [&amp;_code]:text-link [&amp;_em]:text-link [&amp;_i]:text-link [&amp;_span]:text-link [&amp;_strong]:text-link" href="https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/MediaDevices/getUserMedia#security">MediaDevices <code class="text-inherit text-xs leading-[130%] font-normal inline-block rounded-md border border-secondary bg-subtle px-1 py-0.5" data-text="true">getUserMedia()</code> security</a> for more details.</li>
</ul>
<h2 class="text-inherit text-[25px] leading-[1.4] font-bold tracking-[-0.021rem] mt-8 mb-3.5 [&amp;_code]:text-[90%] max-md:text-[22px] max-md:leading-[1.409] max-sm:text-[19px] max-sm:leading-[1.5263] group flex gap-1 scroll-m-5" data-heading="true" id="api">API<a class="border border-solid rounded-full font-medium items-center whitespace-nowrap gap-2 text-sm border-button-quaternary bg-button-quaternary text-button-quaternary shadow-none hocus:bg-button-quaternary-hover active:scale-98 relative my-auto inline-flex size-6.25 min-w-6.25 justify-center p-0 transition-all duration-default invisible opacity-0 group-hover:visible group-hover:opacity-100 group-focus-visible:visible group-focus-visible:opacity-100" href="/versions/v57.0.0/sdk/audio#api"><span class="flex self-center text-inherit leading-none select-none"><svg aria-label="permalink" class="icon-sm shrink-0" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M10 13a5 5 0 007.54.54l3-3a5 5 0 00-7.07-7.07l-1.72 1.71" stroke="#9B9B9B" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"></path><path d="M14 11a5 5 0 00-7.54-.54l-3 3a5 5 0 007.07 7.07l1.71-1.71" stroke="#9B9B9B" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"></path></svg></span></a></h2>

<ul class="leading-[1.6154] text-inherit list-disc ml-6 [&amp;_ol]:mt-2 [&amp;_ol]:mb-4 [&amp;_ul]:mt-2 [&amp;_ul]:mb-4 mb-2.5 [table_&amp;]:last:mb-0">
<li class="text-inherit font-normal mb-2 text-sm" data-text="true"><code class="text-inherit text-xs leading-[130%] font-normal inline-block rounded-md border border-secondary bg-subtle px-1 inline! py-0 wrap-break-word" data-text="true">&#x27;doNotMix&#x27;</code>: Requests exclusive audio focus. Other apps will pause their audio.</li>
<li class="text-inherit font-normal mb-2 text-sm" data-text="true"><code class="text-inherit text-xs leading-[130%] font-normal inline-block rounded-md border border-secondary bg-subtle px-1 inline! py-0 wrap-break-word" data-text="true">&#x27;duckOthers&#x27;</code>: Requests audio focus with ducking. Other apps lower their volume but continue playing.</li>
<li class="text-inherit font-normal mb-2 text-sm" data-text="true"><code class="text-inherit text-xs leading-[130%] font-normal inline-block rounded-md border border-secondary bg-subtle px-1 inline! py-0 wrap-break-word" data-text="true">&#x27;mixWithOthers&#x27;</code>: Audio plays alongside other apps without interrupting them.
On Android, this means no audio focus is requested. Best suited for sound effects,
UI feedback, or short audio clips.</li>

<p class="text-inherit font-normal text-[14px] leading-[1.5715] tracking-[-0.006rem] mb-2.5 [table_&amp;]:last:mb-0" data-text="true">When enabled, this ensures the audio file is fully downloaded before playback begins.
This can improve playback performance and reduce buffering, especially for users
managing multiple audio players simultaneously.</p>
<p class="text-inherit font-normal text-[14px] leading-[1.5715] tracking-[-0.006rem] mb-2.5 [table_&amp;]:last:mb-0" data-text="true">On Android and iOS, this will download the audio file to the device&#x27;s tmp directory before playback begins.
The system will purge the file at its discretion.</p>
<p class="text-inherit font-normal text-[14px] leading-[1.5715] tracking-[-0.006rem] mb-2.5 [table_&amp;]:last:mb-0" data-text="true">On web, this will download the audio file to the user&#x27;s device memory and make it available for the user to play.

[table_&amp;]:px-0"><p class="text-inherit font-normal text-[14px] leading-[1.5715] tracking-[-0.006rem] mb-2.5 [table_&amp;]:last:mb-0" data-text="true">Audio interruption behavior modes.</p>
<p class="text-inherit font-normal text-[14px] leading-[1.5715] tracking-[-0.006rem] mb-2.5 [table_&amp;]:last:mb-0" data-text="true">Controls how your app&#x27;s audio interacts with other apps&#x27; audio.</p>
<ul class="leading-[1.6154] text-inherit list-disc ml-6 [&amp;_ol]:mt-2 [&amp;_ol]:mb-4 [&amp;_ul]:mt-2 [&amp;_ul]:mb-4 mb-2.5 [table_&amp;]:last:mb-0">
<li class="text-inherit font-normal mb-2 text-sm" data-text="true">
<p class="text-inherit font-normal text-[14px] leading-[1.5715] tracking-[-0.006rem] mb-2.5 [table_&amp;]:last:mb-0" data-text="true"><code class="text-inherit text-xs leading-[130%] font-normal inline-block rounded-md border border-secondary bg-subtle px-1 inline! py-0 wrap-break-word" data-text="true">&#x27;doNotMix&#x27;</code>: Requests exclusive audio focus. Other apps will pause their audio.</p>
</li>
<li class="text-inherit font-normal mb-2 text-sm" data-text="true">
<p class="text-inherit font-normal text-[14px] leading-[1.5715] tracking-[-0.006rem] mb-2.5 [table_&amp;]:last:mb-0" data-text="true"><code class="text-inherit text-xs leading-[130%] font-normal inline-block rounded-md border border-secondary bg-subtle px-1 inline! py-0 wrap-break-word" data-text="true">&#x27;duckOthers&#x27;</code>: Requests audio focus with ducking. Other apps lower their volume but continue playing.</p>
</li>
<li class="text-inherit font-normal mb-2 text-sm" data-text="true">
<p class="text-inherit font-normal text-[14px] leading-[1.5715] tracking-[-0.006rem] mb-2.5 [table_&amp;]:last:mb-0" data-text="true"><code class="text-inherit text-xs leading-[130%] font-normal inline-block rounded-md border border-secondary bg-subtle px-1 inline! py-0 wrap-break-word" data-text="true">&#x27;mixWithOthers&#x27;</code>: Audio plays alongside other apps without interrupting them.</p>
<p class="text-inherit font-normal text-[14px] leading-[1.5715] tracking-[-0.006rem] mb-2.5 [table_&amp;]:last:mb-0" data-text="true">On Android, this means no audio focus is requested. Best suited for sound effects,
UI feedback, or short audio clips. Note that on Android your app won&#x27;t receive
audio focus loss callbacks (for example, during phone calls) when using this mode.</p>
</li>

[table_&amp;]:px-0"><p class="text-inherit font-normal text-[14px] leading-[1.5715] tracking-[-0.006rem] mb-2.5 [table_&amp;]:last:mb-0" data-text="true">Recording source for android.</p>
<p class="text-inherit font-normal text-[14px] leading-[1.5715] tracking-[-0.006rem] mb-2.5 [table_&amp;]:last:mb-0" data-text="true">An audio source defines both a default physical source of audio signal, and a recording configuration.</p>
<ul class="leading-[1.6154] text-inherit list-disc ml-6 [&amp;_ol]:mt-2 [&amp;_ol]:mb-4 [&amp;_ul]:mt-2 [&amp;_ul]:mb-4 mb-2.5 [table_&amp;]:last:mb-0">
<li class="text-inherit font-normal mb-2 text-sm" data-text="true"><code class="text-inherit text-xs leading-[130%] font-normal inline-block rounded-md border border-secondary bg-subtle px-1 inline! py-0 wrap-break-word" data-text="true">camcorder</code>: Microphone audio source tuned for video recording, with the same orientation as the camera if available.</li>
<li class="text-inherit font-normal mb-2 text-sm" data-text="true"><code class="text-inherit text-xs leading-[130%] font-normal inline-block rounded-md border border-secondary bg-subtle px-1 inline! py-0 wrap-break-word" data-text="true">default</code>: The default audio source.</li>
<li class="text-inherit font-normal mb-2 text-sm" data-text="true"><code class="text-inherit text-xs leading-[130%] font-normal inline-block rounded-md border border-secondary bg-subtle px-1 inline! py-0 wrap-break-word" data-text="true">mic</code>: Microphone audio source.</li>
<li class="text-inherit font-normal mb-2 text-sm" data-text="true"><code class="text-inherit text-xs leading-[130%] font-normal inline-block rounded-md border border-secondary bg-subtle px-1 inline! py-0 wrap-break-word" data-text="true">unprocessed</code>: Microphone audio source tuned for unprocessed (raw) sound if available, behaves like <code class="text-inherit text-xs leading-[130%] font-normal inline-block rounded-md border border-secondary bg-subtle px-1 inline! py-0 wrap-break-word" data-text="true">default</code> otherwise.</li>
<li class="text-inherit font-normal mb-2 text-sm" data-text="true"><code class="text-inherit text-xs leading-[130%] font-normal inline-block rounded-md border border-secondary bg-subtle px-1 inline! py-0 wrap-break-word" data-text="true">voice_communication</code>: Microphone audio source tuned for voice communications such as VoIP. It will for instance take advantage of echo cancellation or automatic gain control if available.</li>
<li class="text-inherit font-normal mb-2 text-sm" data-text="true"><code class="text-inherit text-xs leading-[130%] font-normal inline-block rounded-md border border-secondary bg-subtle px-1 inline! py-0 wrap-break-word" data-text="true">voice_performance</code>: Source for capturing audio meant to be processed in real time and played back for live performance (e.g karaoke). The capture path will minimize latency and coupling with playback path.</li>
<li class="text-inherit font-normal mb-2 text-sm" data-text="true"><code class="text-inherit text-xs leading-[130%] font-normal inline-block rounded-md border border-secondary bg-subtle px-1 inline! py-0 wrap-break-word" data-text="true">voice_recognition</code>: Microphone audio source tuned for voice recognition.</li>
</ul><blockquote class="mb-4 flex rounded-md border border-default gap-2 px-3 py-2.5 [table_&amp;]:last:mb-0 [&amp;_code]:bg-element [&amp;_a]:text-[#0c6ec4] [&amp;_a:visited]:text-[#0c6ec4] dark:[&amp;_a]:text-link dark:[&amp;_a:visited]:text-link bg-default [&amp;_p]:mb-0! shadow-none mb-2.5! <p class="text-inherit font-normal text-[14px] leading-[1.5715] tracking-[-0.006rem] mb-2.5 [table_&amp;]:last:mb-0" data-text="true"><span class="leading-[1.6154] text-inherit font-semibold" data-text="true">Platform behavior:</span></p>
<ul class="leading-[1.6154] text-inherit list-disc ml-6 [&amp;_ol]:mt-2 [&amp;_ol]:mb-4 [&amp;_ul]:mt-2 [&amp;_ul]:mb-4 mb-2.5 [table_&amp;]:last:mb-0">
<li class="text-inherit font-normal mb-2 text-sm" data-text="true">Android: Ignored, recording starts immediately</li>
<li class="text-inherit font-normal mb-2 text-sm" data-text="true">iOS: Uses native AVAudioRecorder.record(atTime:) for precise timing.</li>
